gaps.explanation: Schedule is 58,511 above the statement. Detail revenue comes only from the Supplementary Budgetary Comparison Schedule for ALL FUNDS COMBINED (p8, detail indexes 0-8, Total Revenues and Transfers 227,614), all tagged governmental, but that schedule combines the governmental funds with the proprietary (utility) fund: its 'Claims, Refunds, Reimbursements, and Other Local Receipts' 97,366 holds the utility collections, and its Sales Tax 24,247 differs from the statement's 23,273 (p4). The combined line cannot be split by fund from the page (97,366 - governmental Interest 394 - Dividend 705 - Electrical Distribution System Lease 33,339 - Charges For Services 2,555 - Claims 1,613 - Licenses 1,223 = 57,537 vs the utility fund's 57,981 on p6). Per the user's per-fund detail ruling (2026-10-27, villages) the combined all-funds lines are replaced by one line per fund column: remove p8 indexes 0-8 (sum 227,614) and add the General Fund column of the governmental funds statement (p4; 14 lines = General Fund Total Revenues 169,028) plus the Fire Department Fund 'Center Usage Charges' 75 from the Other Governmental Funds combining schedule (p10; this printed line was missing from detail - only that fund's transfer out was recorded; the statement prints it as Charges For Services in the Other Governmental Funds column). Check: 227,614 + 169,028 + 75 - 227,614 = 169,103 = statement Total Revenues (p4). General Fund expenditures stay from the p9 combining schedule (unchanged). Note: the p8 budget column is lost with the removed lines.
